ICON_KEY.description:

consumer resolves this against its own local asset set.

CCTCategoryRollup.description:
An observed count of catalogue items in one category.

Counts are VOLATILE and are never part of the ratified taxonomy itself. A
rollup exists only with COUNTED_AT and SOURCE_CATALOG_ID, so a published
count can never omit when it was taken or what it was taken over. A consumer
that needs a live number computes it from the items; a consumer rendering a
published rollup MUST show it as of COUNTED_AT.

ITEM_COUNT.description:
Number of catalogue items whose PRIMARY_CATEGORY or CATEGORIES include
CODE, counted over SOURCE_CATALOG_ID at COUNTED_AT.

SOURCE_CATALOG_ID.description: Identifier of the catalogue the count was taken over.

COUNTED_AT.description: Unix seconds when the count was taken.

CCT.description:
$CCT — Capability Category Taxonomy.

The ratified set of capability classes that distributable units (modules,
applications, composed flows) are classified under, together with the labels
and routes every consuming surface renders. One published $CCT is the single
source of truth shared by a storefront, a library, a search index and the
unit manifests themselves.

Division of labour: `$CCT` = the category vocabulary and its presentation;
`$PLG` = one module's listing, which cites categories by code; `$APP` = one
application's manifest, which cites categories by code; `$PMM` = which
modules a provider serves; `$STO`/`$STF` = commerce.

TAXONOMY_ID.description: Stable identifier of this taxonomy publication.

VERSION.description: SemVer 2.0.0 version of the taxonomy content.

ISSUED_AT.description: Unix seconds when this taxonomy revision was issued.

CATEGORIES.description:
The ratified categories. Every capabilityClass member a consumer may
encounter SHOULD appear exactly once; a code appearing twice is invalid.

ROLLUPS.description:
Optional per-category item counts as observed over a named catalogue.
Absent means counts are computed by the consumer.

SIGNATURE.description: Signature from the publishing node key over the canonical taxonomy bytes.

APPModuleRef.description:
One member WASM module of the app. References module identity; never
embeds the module artifact itself (delivery is the module-bundle lane).

ID.description:
App-local stable reference for this module. Required, unique within
the manifest.

PLUGIN_ID.description: Plugin identifier of the module as published in its plugin listing.

CONTENT_HASH.description:
64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the module's
portable (pre-AOT, publication-trailer-stripped) WASM bytes. This is
the identity capability policies and signature policies key on.

VERSION.description: Module version expected by the app.

ROLE.description: Free-text launcher hint, for example primary, worker, or ui-host.

MAX_WALL_CLOCK_MS.description:
Per-invocation wall-clock budget override in milliseconds. Zero means
the host runtime default applies.

MAX_COST_UNITS.description:
Per-invocation execution-cost (fuel) budget override. Zero means the
host runtime default applies.

MAX_MEMORY_PAGES.description:
Linear-memory ceiling override in 64 KiB WASM pages. Zero means the
host runtime default applies.

RUNTIME_TARGET.description:
Where this module is instantiated. PAGE or BOTH means the module also
loads in the browser: the page resolves its bytes by CONTENT_HASH over
IPFS and instantiates it through the SAME isomorphic module-sdk harness
ABI the SDN nodes use (manifest + plugin_invoke_stream) — never through
a bespoke page-only loader. Defaults to NODE to preserve the prior
node-only behavior of manifests written before this field existed.

NODE.description: Loads only in the desktop/server node runtime.

PAGE.description: Loads in the page through the isomorphic JS harness.

BOTH.description: Loads in both hosts from the same content-addressed bytes and ABI.

APPDataRef.description:
One SDS record type the app produces and/or consumes. Names an existing
spacedatastandards.org schema by its established code; the app manifest
defines no data schemas of its own.

ID.description:
App-local stable reference for this data binding. Required, unique
within the manifest.

SDS_TYPE.description: Existing SDS schema code, for example OMM, CDM, or EPM. Required.

DIRECTION.description: Data flow relative to the app.

MODULE_ID.description:
When present, must equal an APPModuleRef.ID in the same manifest — the
member module responsible for this data binding.

APPSourceRef.description: One upstream data source the app depends on.

ID.description:
App-local stable reference for this source. Required, unique within
the manifest.

MODULE.description: REF is an APPModuleRef.ID in the same manifest — one member module is itself the source for another.

EXTERNAL_API.description: REF is a URL or endpoint identifier outside the app.

DATASET.description: REF is a dataset or catalog identifier.

REF.description:
Source identifier: an APPModuleRef.ID when KIND is MODULE, otherwise a
URL or dataset identifier. Required.

APPUIPage.description:
One UI page of the app. Exactly one of the two delivery mechanisms must
be populated: inline CONTENT (with ENCODING describing its string form),
or MODULE_ID plus URL for a page served by a member module. Inline pages
must be fully self-contained — CSS and JS inlined, all assets embedded
as data URIs, zero external requests.

ID.description:
App-local stable reference for this page. Required, unique within the
manifest.

TITLE.description: Display title. Falls back to the app NAME when empty.

DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable summary. Falls back to the app DESCRIPTION when empty.

ICON.description: Launcher icon identifier or inline data URI.

COLOR.description: Launcher accent color, CSS color syntax.

TEXT_COLOR.description: Launcher text color, CSS color syntax.

CONTENT.description:
Inlined, self-contained page in the string form declared by ENCODING.
Empty when the page is module-served via MODULE_ID and URL.

UTF8.description: CONTENT is the literal page text, UTF-8.

BASE64.description: CONTENT is RFC 4648 standard base64 (with padding) of the page bytes.

BASE64_GZIP.description: CONTENT is base64 of the gzip-compressed page bytes.

BASE64_BROTLI.description: CONTENT is base64 of the Brotli-compressed page bytes.

MEDIA_TYPE.description: IANA media type of the decoded page bytes, for example text/html.

CONTENT_SHA256.description:
64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the decoded
page bytes, so a launcher can verify inline content after decoding.

ENTRY.description:
True for the page the launcher opens first. Exactly one page in an
app must set this when UI is present.

MODULE_ID.description:
When module-served, must equal an APPModuleRef.ID in the same
manifest — the member module that serves this page.

URL.description:
When module-served, the path or entrypoint the module serves the page
at.

APPDataflow.description:
One unit of the page's data contract: a named flow describing what data
enters or leaves the running page, the SDS standard it carries, how it is
transported, and — when applicable — the loaded module method port bound
to it. Standards-only rule: every flow payload is an SDS record (a
canonical size-prefixed FlatBuffer) or a CID pointing at one; this table
defines no data shapes of its own, it only references an existing
spacedatastandards.org schema by its established code. Locators are
content-addressed and IPFS-first.

NAME.description:
App-local stable name for this flow. Required, unique within the
manifest.

DIRECTION.description: Which way the payload crosses the page boundary at runtime.

TO_PAGE.description: Data is delivered into the page for display or module input.

FROM_PAGE.description: Data is emitted by the page (a module output or user action) for publication or upstream consumption.

BIDIRECTIONAL.description: Data crosses in both directions over the same channel.

SDS_SCHEMA.description:
Existing SDS schema code carried by this flow, for example OMM, OEM, or
PNM. Required. Mirrors APPDataRef.SDS_TYPE but named for the standard
the flow carries; the app defines no schema of its own.

TRANSPORT.description:
Transport that moves the payload. Defaults to IPFS_CID per the
content-addressed, IPFS-first rule.

IPFS_CID.description: LOCATOR is a CID; the page fetches the SDS record bytes by content through the serving node's IPFS gateway.

PUBSUB_TOPIC.description: LOCATOR is a gossip topic name; live SDS records arrive on the topic via the node's pubsub bus.

GATEWAY_ROUTE.description: LOCATOR is a same-origin HTTP route template served by the node that serves the page (used for request-scoped queries and streaming).

LOCATOR.description:
Where to fetch or reach the payload, interpreted per TRANSPORT: a CID
for IPFS_CID, a gossip topic name for PUBSUB_TOPIC, or a same-origin
route template for GATEWAY_ROUTE.

MODULE_ID.description:
When present, must equal an APPModuleRef.ID in the same manifest — the
loaded module that produces or consumes this flow. Binds the flow to a
specific module method port together with METHOD_ID and PORT_ID.

METHOD_ID.description:
When present, the PLG.PLGMethodManifest.METHOD_ID on MODULE_ID that
this flow is bound to.

PORT_ID.description:
When present, the PLG.PLGPortManifest.PORT_ID on METHOD_ID that this
flow is bound to.

CONTENT_ENCODING.description:
String/compression form of the payload as it crosses the channel,
reusing the page content-encoding vocabulary. For flows carrying
canonical SDS FlatBuffer bytes (or a CID string), UTF8 denotes the raw
bytes/string with no extra wrapper; BASE64, BASE64_GZIP, and
BASE64_BROTLI denote a base64 text wrapper (optionally compressed)
applied when the channel is text-only.

UTF8.description: CONTENT is the literal page text, UTF-8.

BASE64.description: CONTENT is RFC 4648 standard base64 (with padding) of the page bytes.

BASE64_GZIP.description: CONTENT is base64 of the gzip-compressed page bytes.

BASE64_BROTLI.description: CONTENT is base64 of the Brotli-compressed page bytes.

APP.description: Application Package Manifest — one launchable app.

ID.description: Stable app identity, unique per publisher. Required.

MODULES.description:
Member WASM modules. Referential integrity: every MODULE_ID and every
MODULE-kind REF elsewhere in the manifest must resolve into this list.

DATA.description: SDS record types produced and consumed.

UI.description: UI pages. Exactly one entry page when nonempty.

CREATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ)
when the manifest was created.

UPDATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ)
when the manifest was last updated.

DATAFLOW.description:
The page's declarative data contract: what data enters and leaves the
running page and how. Referential integrity: every MODULE_ID here must
resolve into MODULES, and each MODULE_ID/METHOD_ID/PORT_ID triple must
name a method port advertised by that module's PLG manifest.

RUNTIME_CLASS.description:
App-wide runtime class, reusing appRuntimeTarget. Lets a pulled manifest
self-describe where the app as a whole is meant to run, instead of that
classification being supplied externally at install time. This is the
app-level DEFAULT/DECLARATION only: an individual APPModuleRef.
RUNTIME_TARGET still governs where that specific member module loads and
may specialize away from RUNTIME_CLASS (for example a NODE-class app
with one PAGE-capable module). Defaults to NODE to preserve the prior
node-only assumption of manifests written before this field existed.

NODE.description: Loads only in the desktop/server node runtime.

PAGE.description: Loads in the page through the isomorphic JS harness.

BOTH.description: Loads in both hosts from the same content-addressed bytes and ABI.

PRIMARY_CATEGORY.description:
The one ratified $CCT category this app is shelved under, using the same
vocabulary and the same semantics as PLG.PRIMARY_CATEGORY, so a storefront
or library shelf holds apps and modules together without translating
between two classification schemes. RUNTIME_CLASS says WHERE an app runs;
PRIMARY_CATEGORY says WHAT IT DOES. They are independent: a NODE-class app
and a PAGE-class app can share a category.
UNSPECIFIED means the publisher did not classify the app; a consumer
renders it ungrouped and never infers a class.

UNSPECIFIED.description: No capability class stated. The publisher did not classify the unit. A consumer MUST render an UNSPECIFIED unit as ungrouped and MUST NOT infer a class from the unit's name, description or tags. Display name: "Unspecified".

PROPAGATION.description: Advancing an object's state forward or backward in time under a force model, and interpolating between computed states. Display name: "Propagation".

ORBIT_DETERMINATION.description: Estimating an object's state or model parameters by fitting to observations or ephemerides. Display name: "Orbit Determination".

MANEUVER_PLANNING.description: Planning, targeting and optimizing trajectory changes, including station-keeping, transfers and collision-avoidance maneuvers. Display name: "Maneuver Planning".

CONJUNCTION_ASSESSMENT.description: Screening for close approaches between objects and quantifying collision probability and miss distance. Display name: "Conjunction Assessment".

REENTRY_AND_BREAKUP.description: Atmospheric reentry, decay prediction, fragmentation and debris-cloud evolution. Display name: "Reentry & Breakup".

ATTITUDE_AND_POINTING.description: Attitude determination and control, body orientation, and pointing or slew planning. Display name: "Attitude & Pointing".

REFERENCE_FRAMES_AND_TIME.description: Coordinate frame realization and transformation, time scale conversion, and earth-orientation parameter handling. Display name: "Reference Frames & Time".

SENSORS_AND_COVERAGE.description: Sensor modelling and tasking, field-of-regard and access computation, and area or target coverage figures of merit. Display name: "Sensors & Coverage".

TRACKING_AND_OBSERVATION.description: Producing, correlating or associating observations of tracked objects, and maintaining tracks from them. Display name: "Tracking & Observation".

RF_AND_COMMUNICATIONS.description: Radio-frequency link modelling, emitter and band characterization, signal capture handling, and communications planning. Display name: "RF & Communications".

ELECTRONIC_WARFARE.description: Interference, jamming, spoofing and countermeasure modelling. Display name: "Electronic Warfare".

SPACE_ENVIRONMENT.description: Atmospheric density, gravity field, magnetic field, radiation, solar and geomagnetic activity, and ionospheric modelling. Display name: "Space Environment".

DATA_SOURCES_AND_INGEST.description: Acquiring bytes from upstream providers and parsing or exporting them across canonical record formats. Display name: "Data Sources & Ingest".

DATA_VALIDATION_AND_QUALITY.description: Validating records for integrity, physical plausibility, continuity and schema conformance, and scoring data quality. Display name: "Data Validation & Quality".

CATALOG_AND_IDENTITY.description: Object catalogue curation, cross-identifier resolution, bus and physical property association, and entity identity. Display name: "Catalog & Identity".

VISUALIZATION_AND_RENDERING.description: Rendering, scene composition, shading and interactive display of space data. Display name: "Visualization & Rendering".

GROUND_SEGMENT_AND_HARDWARE.description: Ground station operation and control of physical equipment, including antenna rotators, radios and other hardware interfaces. Display name: "Ground Segment & Hardware".

MISSION_DESIGN_AND_ANALYSIS.description: Mission and constellation design, trade studies, performance analysis and report generation. Display name: "Mission Design & Analysis".

FLOW_AND_COMPOSITION.description: Composition of other units into a graph. The unit of distribution is a flow of modules, not a leaf algorithm. Display name: "Flows & Composition".

DATA_STORAGE_AND_QUERY.description: Persisting, indexing and querying records; storage engines and query surfaces. Display name: "Data Storage & Query".

SECURITY_AND_IDENTITY.description: Key custody, signing and verification, authentication, authorization and access control. Display name: "Security & Identity".

COMMERCE_AND_LICENSING.description: Listing, purchase, subscription, entitlement and license enforcement for distributed units. Display name: "Commerce & Licensing".

NODE_INFRASTRUCTURE.description: Node runtime, artifact delivery, registry, publication and peer transport plumbing. Display name: "Node Infrastructure".

FOUNDATION_AND_MATH.description: Foundational mathematics and general-purpose utility libraries consumed by other units rather than run on their own. Display name: "Foundation & Math".

CATEGORIES.description:
Every ratified $CCT category this app belongs to, for browse, filter and
per-category counting. An app MAY carry several. If nonempty it MUST
include PRIMARY_CATEGORY. Codes MUST NOT repeat.
